add-png-image-to-pdf-page.title: Add PNG Image to PDF Page Using PdfFileMend
add-png-image-to-pdf-page.description: Shows how to bind an existing PDF with Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileMend, insert a PNG image onto page two at specific coordinates, and save the modified document.

replace-jpeg-with-bmp-first-page.title: Replace JPEG with High‑Resolution BMP on First PDF Page
replace-jpeg-with-bmp-first-page.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, locating the first image on the first page, and replacing it with a higher‑resolution BMP stream using Aspose.Pdf's Replace method, then saving the updated document.

overlay-semi-transparent-gif-on-pdf.title: Overlay Semi-Transparent GIF on PDF Page
overlay-semi-transparent-gif-on-pdf.description: Shows how to place a semi‑transparent GIF over an existing PNG in a PDF by using an ImageStamp with opacity and positioning it to cover the printable area.

add-wrapped-footer-to-pdf-pages.title: Add Word-Wrapped Footer to PDF Pages
add-wrapped-footer-to-pdf-pages.description: Shows how to insert a formatted, word‑by‑word wrapped footer on every page of a PDF using PdfFileMend and FormattedText.

add-promotional-text-to-specific-pdf-pag.title: Add Promotional Text to Specific PDF Pages
add-promotional-text-to-specific-pdf-pag.description: Demonstrates how to insert the same promotional message on pages 3, 5, and 7 of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf's PdfFileMend.AddText with an array of page numbers.

add-multi-line-text-block-page-3.title: Add Multi‑Line Text with Custom Line Spacing to Page 3
add-multi-line-text-block-page-3.description: Demonstrates how to insert a multi‑line text block with custom line spacing into the left margin of the third page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

add-image-and-text-watermark-to-pdf.title: Add Image and Text Watermark to PDF
add-image-and-text-watermark-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF, overlay a semi‑transparent image stamp and a rotated semi‑transparent text stamp as a watermark, and then save the result.

add-background-png-to-all-pdf-pages.title: Add Background PNG Image to All PDF Pages
add-background-png-to-all-pdf-pages.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF, iterate through each page, and add a full‑page PNG background using an ImageStamp placed behind existing content.

add-header-image-to-pdf-documents.title: Add Header Image to PDF Pages
add-header-image-to-pdf-documents.description: Shows how to load PDF files with Aspose.Pdf, create an ImageStamp for a header graphic, place it on every page, and save the updated documents to an output folder.

batch-add-company-logo-to-pdfs.title: Add Company Logo to PDFs in Batch
batch-add-company-logo-to-pdfs.description: Demonstrates how to iterate through a folder of PDF files and stamp a PNG logo onto the top‑right corner of each page using Aspose.Pdf.

insert-png-signature-image-on-every-pdf-.title: Insert PNG Signature on Every PDF Page
insert-png-signature-image-on-every-pdf-.description: Demonstrates how to use PdfFileMend to add a PNG signature image to the bottom‑left corner of each page in a PDF document.

add-tiff-image-to-last-page-pdf.title: Add TIFF Image to Last PDF Page with PdfFileMend
add-tiff-image-to-last-page-pdf.description: Shows how to use Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileMend to insert a TIFF image onto the last page of an existing PDF without altering the original content.

add-image-to-each-pdf-page-dynamic-posit.title: Add Centered Image to Each PDF Page
add-image-to-each-pdf-page-dynamic-posit.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, retrieving each page's dimensions, and dynamically placing a centered image stamp on every page.

add-image-to-pdf-with-format-validation.title: Add Image Stamp to PDF with Format Validation
add-image-to-pdf-with-format-validation.description: Demonstrates how to validate an image file's format and then add it as a stamp to a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

add-image-to-pdf-using-pdffilemend.title: Modify PDF with PdfFileMend and Ensure Proper Cleanup
add-image-to-pdf-using-pdffilemend.description: Demonstrates loading, modifying, and saving a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileMend while guaranteeing that changes are flushed by calling Close() inside a try‑finally block.

add-images-to-pdf-with-error-handling.title: Add Images to PDF with Error Handling
add-images-to-pdf-with-error-handling.description: Shows how to load a PDF, add multiple images to a page using Aspose.Pdf, and catch exceptions to log problematic image file paths.

add-image-and-text-to-pdf-with-audit-log.title: Add Images and Text to PDF with Audit Logging
add-image-and-text-to-pdf-with-audit-log.description: Demonstrates inserting image stamps and text fragments onto specific PDF pages using Aspose.Pdf and records each operation with a timestamp, page number, and file name in an audit log.

configure-word-wrapping-bywords-add-long.title: Add Word‑Wrapped Text to PDF Using PdfFileMend
configure-word-wrapping-bywords-add-long.description: Demonstrates how to enable word‑wrap mode ByWords with PdfFileMend and insert a long paragraph that automatically wraps within a defined rectangle.

add-image-to-pdf-page.title: Add Image to Specific PDF Page
add-image-to-pdf-page.description: Shows how to insert an image onto a chosen page of a PDF at exact coordinates using Aspose.Pdf's ImageStamp.

async-add-image-to-pdf.title: Asynchronously Add Text Watermark to PDF
async-add-image-to-pdf.description: Shows how to apply a semi‑transparent "Confidential" text stamp to every page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf and wrap the operation in Task.Run for non‑blocking asynchronous execution.

extract-images-from-pdf-pages.title: Extract Images from Specific PDF Pages to a Temporary Folder
extract-images-from-pdf-pages.description: Demonstrates how to extract all images from pages 2 through 5 of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades and save them to a uniquely created temporary directory.

batch-extract-images-from-pdfs.title: Extract Images from PDFs and Rename by Page and Index
batch-extract-images-from-pdfs.description: The example iterates through all PDF files in a folder, extracts every image from each page, and saves the images with filenames that include the original PDF name, page number, and image index.

remove-image-from-pdf-page.title: Remove Image by Object ID from PDF Page
remove-image-from-pdf-page.description: Demonstrates how to delete a specific image from a given PDF page using its object ID with Aspose.Pdf. The example loads a document, validates the page, removes the image resource, and saves the result.

replace-low-res-images-with-high-res-png.title: Replace Low‑Resolution Images with High‑Resolution PNGs
replace-low-res-images-with-high-res-png.description: Demonstrates how to iterate through PDF pages and image resources, locate matching high‑resolution PNG files, and replace the low‑resolution images using Aspose.Pdf.

add-text-at-coordinates-verify-position.title: Verify Text Position in PDF Using Aspose.Pdf
add-text-at-coordinates-verify-position.description: Creates a PDF, places a text fragment at specific X/Y coordinates, then loads the document and validates the fragment's position with TextFragmentAbsorber.

add-image-verify-pdf-byte-size.title: Add Image Stamp to PDF and Verify Size Increase
add-image-verify-pdf-byte-size.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, add an image stamp to each page, save the modified document, and confirm that the file size grew after the image was added.

add-image-to-pdf-and-send-response.title: Add Image to PDF and Send as HTTP Response
add-image-to-pdf-and-send-response.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, stamping an image onto its first page, and streaming the modified document back through an HTTP response.

extract-images-from-pdf-to-png__v2.title: Extract Images from PDF to PNG Files
extract-images-from-pdf-to-png__v2.description: Shows how to use Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor to extract every image from a PDF document and save each one as an individual PNG file.

remove-all-images-from-pdf__v2.title: Remove All Images from a PDF
remove-all-images-from-pdf__v2.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, iterate through each page, clear the image resources, and save the resulting image‑free document.
